title: Event Sourcing in Serverless Architectures
description: Event sourcing with AWS Lambda and DynamoDB Streams: an append-only event store with optimistic concurrency, a stream-triggered projection handler, and aggregate reconstruction by event replay.
description_es: Event sourcing con AWS Lambda y DynamoDB Streams: un event store append-only con concurrencia optimista, un handler de proyección disparado por el stream y reconstrucción del agregado por replay de eventos.
